title: DSP to AI: From Signal Processing to Deep Learning
description:
An interactive educational website bridging classical Digital Signal Processing with modern AI. 27 chapters and 51 interactive tools trace the path from signals, convolution and IIR filters to attention, state-space models and Mamba, and then examine where the analogies hold and where they break.

Live site: https://ashyraw.github.io/DSP-to-AI/. Source: https://github.com/AshYRaw/DSP-to-AI.
